{{Quote|If the canisters were damaged, the bospridium gas will eat both flesh and circuits.|[[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]] [[Kroius]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Bospridium''' (Bo) was an element that was extremely toxic to both flesh and circuitry in gas form. It was also one of the elements rumored to compose [[Bavo Six]].
